description: This file contains the definition of the 'Basket' entity class within an e-commerce application. The class manages basket items, including adding, removing, and retrieving basket details, and implements business logic related to the shopping basket.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket with items for a specific buyer, providing methods to add, remove, and manage items.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Basket with a buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or updates the quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items from the basket where the quantity is zero.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with this basket.
